I recently had the privilege of meeting Magnus Carlsen—widely considered the best chess player of all time—as one of 23 students invited to the inaugural US Chess Academy, hosted by IMC Trading and Team Liquid . Alongside some of the top collegiate players in the country, I traveled to Chicago for an unforgettable opportunity to meet, play, and learn from iconic Grandmasters: Magnus, Fabiano Caruana, and Robert Hess. Watching Magnus and Fabi teach a masterclass, before having the chance to play against them, was a dream come true. Additionally, the weekend included a boat cruise and tournament, where I got to connect with and compete against other top players from across North America. I was also able to learn more about the amazing work that happens at IMC's office and the captivating world of quantitative trading. It was fascinating to hear IMC and Team Liquid's perspective on the future of chess and how chess players can leverage the skills the game develops, whether in their professional careers, trading, or beyond. Thank you to Melissa Roe , Murad Abdulla , and everyone at IMC Trading, Team Liquid, and the US Chess Academy who helped put on this once-in-a-lifetime opportunity. Additionally, thank you to the other participants I met for making the weekend such an enjoyable experience. ...more ...more

Chert (YC P26) is building the infrastructure for teams to send, receive, and automate conversations over iMessage using APIs. iMessage is one of the most trusted and widely used messaging channels in the U.S. People use it every day to talk with friends, book appointments, coordinate plans, and have conversations. But for businesses, iMessage is still very difficult to automate programmatically. Chert is changing that by giving teams API access to iMessage. They’re already working with B2C startups, customer experience teams, and sales teams to reach end users through trusted and conversational messaging.
